text:
incident-bot: 🚨 High-rate 5xxs for /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 (routing spike). Alert grouping: embeddings->chat fallback.
emma: seeing same in console, spikes started ~3897654300. Tens of customers hitting gen errors. Paging oncall now.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8421 triggered, oncall: @emma
emma: oncall taking. quick triage: are we dealing with a mis-pinned variant or runtime bug?
raj: I pulled the route logs. There's a sudden anchor pin update from the control plane mapping alias `embed-fast` -> `model-chat-v2` at 3897654298. That's wrong variant.
sofia: confirmed. routing table snapshot: ```
alias: embed-fast
pinned_variant: model-chat-v2
fallback_policy: allow-interface-fallback
```
sofia: requests expecting embeddings are being routed to a chat-optimized variant causing schema mismatches and 415/500s from model adapter.
lucy-cs: Customer impact: two paying customers (org-771, org-999) reported failed embeddings for search indexing jobs. Support already opened tickets.
marc: we need mitigation steps: (1) revert anchor, (2) disable interface fallbacks for aliases, (3) customer communication.
tom: I can push a hotfix to reject interface-incompatible fallbacks at the routing layer. Patching now.
emma: plan: (A) remove incorrect pin -> set alias back to `model-embed-v3` (B) temporarily set fallback_policy: "no-interface-fallback" for embed aliases in eu-west-1 (C) throttle replay traffic to affected orgs. Oncall will execute.
raj: rollback command I'm running:
```
# control-plane cli
redwood alias update --name embed-fast --pinned_variant model-embed-v3 --region eu-west-1 --force
```
raj: command applied, control plane shows pinned_variant=model-embed-v3 at 3897654342.
sofia: pushed policy change to prevent interface fallbacks: ```
redwood policy set embed-fast --no-interface-fallback --region eu-west-1
```
sofia: policy applied at 3897654350. routing metrics: error rate dropping.
emma: logs show a drop in 5xxs from ~18% -> ~2% over next 30s. Customer tickets still open but ingestion backfilling should resume.
lucy-cs: Notifying affected customers: drafting a quick status. Marc please review.
marc: LGTM. Include root cause (bad anchor pin from automated deploy job) and ETA for postmortem.
sofia: preliminary root cause: automated alias pin job used wrong variant mapping due to a stale mapping cache in the release pipeline. Investigating whether rollout validation missed interface compatibility checks.
tom: adding safe-guard: validate alias variant interface compatibility before commit. I'll open PR with tests.
emma: escalation: no immediate SLA breach but meaningful customer interruption. I'll assign postmortem to sofia + raj, follow-up in #postmortems.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-8421 acknowledged by emma at 3897654360.
sofia: saving artifacts: routing audit log: ```
[3897654298] alias=embed-fast set_pinned=model-chat-v2 by release-bot-42
[3897654342] alias=embed-fast set_pinned=model-embed-v3 by raj
[3897654350] policy=embed-fast no-interface-fallback by sofia
```
emma: next steps: support notify customers (lucy), prod roll (tom) adds compatibility check, infra (raj) validate control plane caches. Postmortem owners: sofia, raj. I'll close this thread when postmortem is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
lucy-cs: I'll send the customer note now, include we restored service and are investigating root cause.
marc: add a short changelog entry for the automation job and a mitigation playbook for mis-pins.
sofia: thanks all. I see error rate stabilized; moving to monitoring. Will file postmortem ticket PM-389.
emma: incident closed for paging handoff. Final status: mitigation applied, customers notified, owners assigned.
